feeds.title: L.A. Parent
feeds.description: Activities, events and fun things to do in L.A. with kids. L.A. Parent is your resource for kids activities in L.A. as well as articles and resources on special needs, summer activities and positive parenting.

feeds.title: MomsLA
feeds.description: We love Los Angeles and think it's a great place to raise our children. Our job is to help you find all the best things to do in Los Angeles - with kids and sometimes without them!We know you're busy raising a family and living the SoCal life. So relax and let us deliver you the info you want - so you can have fun!

feeds.title: Tinseltown Mom
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Tirralan, founder and editor of Tinseltown Mom. I'm also a devoted wife to a talented and loving filmmaker and mom to two adorable sons. Tinseltown Mom focuses on famous mothers in their daily lives: the good, the bad, the happy, and sometimes sad. The goal is to inspire regular Moms who revere well-known Moms, so they can see that we are all alike in many respects.

feeds.title: Savvy Sassy Moms
feeds.description: Parenting tips and advice for every parent. Jenna Greenspoon is the mom behind Savvy Sassy Moms. She is both Savvy and Sassy, like many moms in our community! She aims to create crafted posts for moms of all types. She is a busy mom herself juggling many different balls, but loves to get it all done!

feeds.title: Jessica Gottlieb
feeds.description: Jessica Gottlieb is an award winning blogger in Los Angeles with bylines in everything from National Lampoon to Parenting Magazine.

feeds.title: The Fab Mom
feeds.description: Hi all. Jill Simonian here. I'm a TV Host & Entertainment Journalist turned Parenting Lifestyle Contributor on-air and online. TheFABMom is about resilient parenting, fierce self-care, and major fun through mom life and beyond.

feeds.title: Kristin Cruz Blog
feeds.description: I am Kristin. My expertise is connecting people, sharing my story, enjoying family life, & discovering the next 'hot trend'. That's what makes me happy (also overusing #hashtags & coffee). You can check me out online anytime & at events. Follow my blog to know what's cooking in my day to day life.

feeds.title: Beyond the Brochure
feeds.description: Christina is the mother of a son and a daughter who attended elementary school at The Willows Community School in Culver City. Beyond the Brochure is a blog for parents who are applying to private elementary schools in Los Angeles.

feeds.title: Make Time For Mom
feeds.description: Make Time for mom blog shares simple, honest, and straightforward systems and insights about the personal and professional life of the author as well as provides inspiration for moms to find time to rest, breath, celebrate, and reclaim their full identities. Make Time for mom is a blog by Maya Yaniv, a mother, blogger, master gardener and outdoor educator based out of Los Angeles, California.
